List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS

Total number of questions — 15
Funds allocated under PMAY in
Himachal Pradesh
*16. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated to Government
of Himachal Pradesh under the Pradhan
Mantri Awaas Yojana (PMAY) in the
financial years 2015-16, 2016-17 and
2017-18;
(b) the names of districts in the State
covered under the scheme; and
(c) the number of houses constructed/
likely to be constructed in Kangra district
under the scheme?
Revision of diversion of  forest land
for Mission Bhagiradha Project
*17. SHRI DHARMAPURI
SRINIVAS: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND
CLIMA TE CHANGE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is in receipt of
any proposal from Telangana Government
seeking revision of diversion of forest land
for Mission Bhagiradha Project;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government has taken any
decision on the matter and if so, the details
thereof?
PMPRPY beneficiaries for textile
sector
*18. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of textile sector
employees registered under Pradhan Mantri
Paridhan Rojgar Protsahan Yojana
(PMPRPY), since its inception, month-
wise;
(b) the quantum of funds disbursed under
the scheme since its inception, month-wise;

7
(c) whether it is a fact that beneficiaries
have not been able to receive their claims
due to errors in Aadhaar linkage to their
PAN numbers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Harassment and manhandling for 
open defecation
†*19. SHRI VISHAMBHAR  
PRASAD NISHAD: Will th e Minister of  
DRINKING WATER AND SANITATION 
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount spent for promotion of  
social awareness under cleanliness drive 
during the last three years;
(b) whether incidents of manhandling 
of people defecating in open and their social 
harassmen t have come to the notice of  
Government; and
(c) the steps being taken by 
Government for creating social awareness  
in order to curb these incidents and the  
extent to which such effo rts h ave been  
fruitful?
Pollution level in Indian cities
*20. SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA: Will 
the Minister of ENVI RONMENT,  
FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE be  
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a recently 
concluded study has revealed that mo st of 
the cities of the country have become  
polluted and pollution has become a life 
threatening menace;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of corrective measures
Government proposes to undertake to
minimise the pollution levels in the
country?
Clearance of margin money by HHEC
*21. SARDAR BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to refer to the
answer to Unstarred Question 1573 given
in Rajya Sabha on 1st January, 2018 and
state:
(a) the details of balance amount as per
Books of Accounts of Handicrafts and
Handlooms Exports Corporation of India
Limited (HHEC), as payable to a private
company;
(b) whether HHEC is in a very difficult
financial position and have sought the help
of the Ministry for financial support in
order to clear the Margin Money of the
company; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
the blocked Margin Money would be paid
to the company?
Status of BPL card holders in the
country
*22. SHRI DEREK O’BRIEN: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of people in the country
having BPL cards as in 2017, Urban and
Rural-wise;
(b) the number of people who have been
added or have applied for inclusion in the
BPL category during the last three years;
(c) whether the Ministry is verifying
the previous card holders to ensure that
they still come under the criterion of BPL
and if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether there are instances of people
availing BPL services illegally and if so, the
details thereof, along with the steps taken
to curb them?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Restoration of ponds for drinking
water
†*23. SHRI MEGHRAJ JAIN: Will the
Minister of DRINKING WA TER AND
SANITA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any special
scheme for restoration of ponds, keeping
in view the problem of drinking water in
the country, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government has received
suggestions in this regard from various
States, if so, the details thereof,
State-wise;
(c) the details of ponds restored during
the last three years under this scheme,
State-wise; and
(d) the details of amount spent on
restoration of ponds during

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, February 5, 2018/Magha 16, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Defence; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Earth Sciences;
Environment, Forest and Climate Change; Information and Broadcasting;
Mines; Panchayati Raj; Road Transport and Highways; Rural Development;
Science and Technology; Shipping; Textiles; Water Resources,
River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation)
Total number of questions — 160
Make in India in Defence sector
161. SHRI C.P. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) which are the areas in Defence in
which Make in India has been newly
introduced;
(b) the number of products developed
by DRDO and other Indian institutions
which are being or are proposed to be mass
produced during the last three years;
(c) how many contracts the present
Government has signed to import defence
equipments and machinery;
(d) whether the existing defence
production factories are closed now or are
on their way to closure; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Budgetary allocation and spending on
defence modernisation
162. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of budgetary allocation
of the Ministry during the current financial
year together with the actual spending so
far;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has sought additional funds for defence
modernisation during the current financial
year;
(c) if so, the details of modernisation
programmes; and
(d) whether the demand for additional
funds have been met by the Ministry of
Finance?
Project of building nuclear powered
submarines
163. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Navy has launched an ambitious project to
build  six  Nuclear-Powered  attack
submarines;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
37

38
(c) what are the other weapons that have
been procured/proposed to be procured to
strengthen the country's Naval Power?
New weapons procurement policy
164. SHRI P. BHA TTACHARY A: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is willing to
implement the new weapons procurement
policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the policies framed by
Government to have latest technologies for
development of weapons in the country;
and
(d) if so, the achievement made so far?
Achievements in Defence sector
165. SHRI P. BHA TTACHARY A: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of achievements made by
Government during the last three years in
Defence sector; and
(b) the details of the action plan
formulated for the next two years in this
regard?
Abolition of community based
regiments
†166. SHRI P.L. PUNIA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there have
been community-based regiments in the
country since pre- independence days, if
so, the details thereof along with their
establishment and names;
(b) whether it is also a fact that many
such regiments have been abolished after
independence, if so,  the details thereof
along with the names thereof; and
(c) whether Government intends to
revive these abolished regiments and if not,
the details thereof along with the reasons
therefor?
Development of long range submarine
based missile system
167. SHRIMATI RENUKA
CHOWDHURY: W ill the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to strongly develop long range submarine
based missile system;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
counter the emerging maritime threats in
Indian Ocean region and maintain strong
deterrence against any such threats?
Disclosure of Rafale deal agreement in
public
†168. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
does not want to disclose in public domain
the  agreement made with France about the
Rafale deal;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the salient features of the
Rafale deal and whether private sector,
which does not have any experience in this
field has also been included in this deal?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
Shortage of ammunition for armed
forces
169. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of additions made to
various types of ammunitions of the armed
forces and the storages in ammunition since
2014;
(b) whether these additions to
ammunition, meet the officially sanctioned
requirement of the war wastage reserve
(WWR) of 40 days of intense war;
(c) if not, the measures taken by
Government to meet the minimum
sanctioned requirement  of ammunitions;
and
(d) the measures taken by Government
to ease the capacity constrains of ordnance
factory boards and augment their
production capacity, since 2014?
